selection_policy: All ten official hardware outer-TRAIN partitions at all three previously measured seeds, without selecting only failed folds.
worker_data_boundary: Controller extracts original outer-TRAIN X/y in original order and writes a checksummed training-only payload. Workers never receive outer-test rows, labels, predictions or test scores.
algorithm_policy: Reproduce unchanged canonical 75/25 inner tuning and final full-TRAIN refit for raw and aligned FE. No changed estimator parameters, feature operators, subset gates, mixture weights or selection rules.
diagnostics: Winning inner and final ordered selected feature-name identities and turnover
Scaled training design singular values, numerical rank and conditioning status
In-sample training residual RMSE, explicitly not an evaluation score
Train-fitted numeric clipping boundary counts with constant/undefined cases separate
diagnostic_limitations: Retrospective dataset choice follows exposed failures; this is not independently selected evidence.
Conditioning and coefficient magnitude alone do not establish causality or a safe selection threshold.
Training residual RMSE is not outer-test performance and must not be combined with benchmark scores.
Training min/max saturation counts describe observed boundaries; they are not future clipping or extrapolation rates.
No clinical, generalization, no-harm, default-promotion or SOTA claim is authorized.
